blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Budget and Management (DBM) will allow local government units (LGUs) that failed to meet their targets to submit explanations and catch-up plans for case-by-case review, potentially opening the door to consideration of their eligibility for the 2026 collective negotiation agreement (CNA) incentive. In a statement, the DBM said it met with the country’s local government leagues and acknowledged that some LGUs could not meet their targets due to procurement delays, failed biddings, calamities, and other circumstances.
